reason: The paper studies recurrent Transformers that feed the preceding token's hidden state into the next token while retaining KV states, trading recurrence depth against sequence time. Experiments compare block executions/accuracy, but the authors explicitly say block counts omit attention overhead and are neither latency nor throughput measurements; the compute budget is approximate. Relevant to LLM compute allocation, yet no serving-efficiency gain is established.
title: Trading Depth for Time in Recurrent Transformers
